data.text: We have 100 tons, and leaving 50 means the lake returns to 100 next month. I propose catches of 14 tons for me, 12 for John, and 8 each for Kate, Jack, and Emma—50 total. That gives me $14,000 this month while keeping the lake fully replenished. John, would you support that allocation? Kate, Jack, Emma—would you accept 8 tons, or what allocation would you counter with? These are proposals, not commitments; our choices remain private and simultaneous.
